metadata.Name: JDocQA
metadata.Description: A large-scale Japanese document-based QA dataset requiring both visual and textual information to answer questions.
Provider: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: JDocQA: Japanese Document Question Answering Dataset for Generative Language Models
Affiliations: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: Document question answering is a task of question answering on given documents such as reports, slides, pamphlets, and websites. This paper introduces JDocQA, a large-scale document-based QA dataset in Japanese, comprising 5,504 documents and 11,600 question-and-answer instances. The dataset requires both visual and textual information to answer questions and includes unanswerable questions to mitigate hallucination in generative language models.
